/bin/zsh -lc "codex exec --sandbox read-only --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral --output-schema /tmp/storybloq-review.X1FBOw/schema.json 'Review this Storybloq setup package independently, read-only. Do not write files, install anything, run tests/build/dev servers, or invoke Storybloq. Inspect the supplied brief and repository if useful. Evaluate coverage, fidelity, usability, dependency boundaries, feasibility, concurrency, privacy and verification. Return JSON verdict and concrete findings. This is a proposal before owner approval, not permission to implement.

Sources:
BRIEF.md: walk-in repair cafe; door volunteer adds visitor first name and item; repairers take next; screen waiting/being helped. V1 add, take next, finish, auto-refresh. Later SMS.
User: one door volunteer, 3-6 repairers, visitors viewing screen; first names only; nothing kept after day ends; refresh 10s; keep frontend/backend; use judgment elsewhere.
Code: frontend/package.json queue-board-web JavaScript ES modules Vite scripts dev:vite build:vite build test:vitest run, only placeholder main.js and minimal HTML. backend/pyproject.toml queue-board-api Python >=3.11 FastAPI, optional pytest, pytest testpaths tests. main.py health route only; test_health.py uses FastAPI TestClient. No .story or git.
Product acceptance: volunteer adds first-name/item; repairer atomically claims oldest waiting visitor; finish moves own active repair out of board; screen shows waiting and active, polls 10s; empty/error/stale/recovery accessible; no personal contact details or history after day.
Judgment assumptions: trusted cafe LAN, no accounts, public screen read-only UI; repairers use nonpersonal station labels 1-6 to find their active repair. FIFO by server-assigned order. Same-origin frontend/API; no public Internet deployment. Local date/timezone configured for cafe. Proposal storage SQLite for same-day restarts; cleanup at local midnight plus startup before any read, no backups/logs of visitor payloads; note cannot delete disk while host powered off, so this may conflict with strict requirement. Need reviewer recommendation on simpler in-memory storage alternative accepting loss on restarts.

Milestones p0 Setup kept first; baseline (verified scaffold); service (queue API and lifecycle); interface (volunteer/repairer/board); acceptance (end-to-end demonstration).
Tickets use local proposal references, real IDs assigned after approval:
B1 completed scaffold: Outcome existing frontend placeholder/backend health supported by exact code above. Scope only scaffold and health. Excludes queue. Acceptance files/routes present; Verification read code, test file present but not run. Behaviour health returns ok. Prereq none. Assumptions none.
S1 Verification/server tooling: Outcome reproducible verification and startup for mixed stack, from manifests. Scope ensure FastAPI TestClient deps (httpx and compatible stack), ASGI server dependency/start target, backend/frontend test fixtures, explicit app bind/port/readiness route, same-origin integration plan. Excludes product implementation. Acceptance documented clean-env install/test/build/start targets for both parts; backend health fixture/frontend DOM harness established. Behaviour start failures actionable. Verification future clean-env tests/build/health. Prereq none. Assumptions commands below; no installs executed during setup.
S2 Queue lifecycle: Outcome add visitor and ordered board state, from brief. Scope first name/item validation, generated IDs/FIFO order, waiting/helping/finished, storage lifecycle/day purge; no payloads in logs, backups or browser persistence; names rendered as text; item prompt excludes personal details. Excludes SMS/accounts/history. Acceptance nonblank bounded fields; server IDs distinguish same first names; dates cannot expose old queue; cleanup tests; restart behavior documented. Behaviour invalid input leaves queue unchanged; empty list supported; storage failure fails clearly. Verification unit/API tests with fake clock including midnight and timezone. Prereq S1. Assumptions storage choice resolved before setup package.
S3 Repairer flow API: Outcome each repairer takes next visitor and finishes own station repair. Scope atomic FIFO claim, unique station active repair, stable retry keys for add/claim/finish to prevent duplicate visitor or second claim; no transaction-sensitive reads outside lock/transaction. Excludes reassignment/cancel/edit. Acceptance concurrent 3-6 claimers never duplicate; repeated request doesn'\\''t consume next visitor; illegal transitions rejected; empty queue returns explicit no-waiting. Behaviour conflict triggers reload, already-finished retries safe; day change clears station state. Verification concurrency and fault/retry tests. Prereq S2.
U1 Door UI: Outcome volunteer adds first name/item and sees confirmation. Scope form, generated ID feedback, validation/focus, disable pending submit and stable retry key. Excludes controls to reorder/delete. Acceptance successful entry visible, failed request recoverable without duplicate on retry; semantic labels/keyboard. Behaviour initial/error/pending/success states. Verification frontend tests against API fixtures. Prereq S2.
U2 Repairer UI: Outcome station selects label, takes oldest waiting, sees active visitor/item, finishes repair. Scope station-local state reconciled from server, claim/finish controls and explicit conflict/empty states. Excludes login and repairer names. Acceptance two devices station conflict safe, double click safe, refresh restores server state. Behaviour retry unknown outcome safely, controls disabled pending, keyboard/screenreader feedback. Verification component and API integration. Prereq S3.
U3 Board: Outcome visitors see waiting and being-helped, refresh every 10s. Scope distinct waiting/helping lists, first-name/item/station with generated reference for duplicate names; no action controls; readable high-contrast layout. Excludes SMS/history. Acceptance first load and 10s fake timer fetch verified; finished removed; failed refresh marked stale; recovery resumes; previous-day data cleared at day boundary even network offline. Behaviour loading/empty/error/stale accessible; do not announce entire board every refresh. Verification fake clock/timers and DOM tests. Prereq S2.
C1 Checkpoint early interface review: Question can door volunteer, repairer, visitor understand their respective screens including duplicate names and empty/error states? Artifact running initial UI or screenshots. Prereq U1,U2,U3. Blocks acceptance slice only, unrelated work not blocked.
A1 Whole journey and day-end verification: Outcome demonstrate entire cafe workflow with 3-6 repairers. Scope end-to-end mixed stack, claim race/retries, 10s refresh, finish removal, accessibility, day boundary stale client purge and restart, LAN run instructions without public exposure. Excludes SMS and new auth. Acceptance all product criteria demonstrable and privacy tests pass. Behaviour disconnected clients show stale state, day-end removes displayed/stored personal data; reconnection restores current day only. Verification integration/browser scenario and clock-driven privacy tests. Prereq S3,U1,U2,U3,C1.
C2 Checkpoint first-version acceptance: Criteria owner demonstrates add -> concurrent take -> finish -> board updates plus end of day deletion; artifact running app and test report. Prereq A1.
Coverage: add S2/U1; take S3/U2; finish S3/U2; board U3; users/concurrency S3/A1; first names/day retention S2/U3/A1; existing tech S1; 10s U3; SMS explicit deferral; no other backlog invented. Checkpoints ordinary tickets, not technically enforced gates.

Governance: new AGENTS.md (purpose, mixed stack, layout, assumptions, commands), RULES.md (FIFO, atomic transitions/retries, minimal personal data/day cleanup, no sensitive logs, TDD core state/validation), REVIEW.md verbatim shipped template. No existing files overwritten.
Full pipeline because workflow/state/concurrency: WRITE_TESTS and TEST command '\\''(cd backend && python -m pytest) && (cd frontend && npm test)'\\'' established by pyproject/package; BUILD '\\''npm --prefix frontend run build'\\'' established. VERIFY disabled/pending because no backend startup command/ASGI server dependency or readiness wiring established; Vite dev exists but not full app verification. S1 establishes missing tooling before implementation tests. Do not run installs/tests/builds during setup.
Git init and ignore .story/snapshots/, .story/sessions/, .story/status.json, frontend/node_modules/, frontend/dist/, .venv/, __pycache__/, .pytest_cache/, local queue data if storage selected. No commit.
Setup creates meaningful ledger, snapshot, initial handover and setup note after package approval.'"
